name: Focused Ion Beam Circuit Editing
description: Use of Focused Ion Beam (FIB) systems to perform precision circuit modifications on integrated circuits. Covers FIB milling to cut conductors, FIB-assisted deposition to create new connections, creation of probe landing pads for microprobing, bypass of security fuses, and targeted modification of circuit functionality. FIB editing is the highest-capability invasive technique, enabling surgical alteration of IC behavior.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to FIB systems or circuit editing

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands FIB system capabilities and applications in IC security analysis
evidence: Can explain FIB milling and deposition processes at a conceptual level
Understands FIB applications in security evaluation (fuse bypass, pad creation, circuit modification)
Aware of FIB imaging modalities (secondary electron, secondary ion) and their uses

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Operates FIB system for basic tasks under supervision
evidence: Loads and navigates a sample in the FIB system under guidance
Performs FIB cross-sections for layer inspection on practice samples
Performs basic conductor cuts on large (top metal) features with supervision
Creates simple probe landing pads via FIB deposition on practice targets

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently performs FIB circuit edits for security analysis objectives
evidence: Plans and executes FIB edits based on IC layout analysis and attack objectives
Cuts and reroutes conductors on target ICs to bypass security mechanisms (fuse bits, lock signals)
Creates reliable probe landing pads on sub-micron features for subsequent microprobing
Completed FIB editing tasks on 3+ distinct target ICs with verified functional results

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Performs complex multi-step FIB edits on advanced nodes; develops edit strategies
evidence: Performs multi-layer FIB edits requiring navigation through multiple metal layers
Edits circuits at sub-100nm features on advanced process nodes
Develops FIB edit strategies from IC layout analysis and reverse-engineered schematics
Mentors team on FIB operation, edit planning, and endpoint detection

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on FIB circuit editing; defines methodology; specifies FIB equipment
evidence: Defines the lab's FIB editing methodology and capability roadmap
Evaluates and specifies FIB system procurement (Ga-FIB, Xe plasma FIB, cryo-FIB)
Pushes the limits of FIB editing on leading-edge process nodes
Provides expert consultation on FIB resistance and anti-FIB countermeasures

assessment_methods.description: Plan and execute a FIB circuit edit on a prepared target: cut a specified conductor, deposit a new connection or probe pad, and verify the edit electrically
Observe FIB system operation, navigation technique, milling precision, and deposition quality during a live editing session

equipment: Focused Ion Beam (FIB) system (e.g., Thermo Fisher Helios, ZEISS Crossbeam)
FIB gas injection system (GIS) for conductor and insulator deposition
